integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Manage built-in MCP and repo / CI credentials; configure environment variables in Agent metadata.

artifactStore.name: artifact-store
artifactStore.desc: Platform artifact store · injected into every node of the run (including sandbox agents) for reading/writing intermediate and final artifacts
artifactStore.overview: Built-in artifact-store MCP. Injected by the orchestrator at run start into all nodes (including sandbox Agents), isolated by run token. Agents read/write artifacts via MCP; the Host persists them.
artifactStore.convention: Sandbox rule (mandatory): for every file listed in the node's produces contract, the agent must write it via write_artifact before ending the turn; after deliverables, the agent must also call node_complete. Validation order is fixed: platform default checks must pass, then optional business RPC. Enforced via injected system rules.

write_artifact.desc: Write a text artifact to the platform store (scoped by run); returns artifact_id. content is text-only — do not inline image base64. For screenshots, run sandbox artifact-upload then reference the printed name in set_test_result.screenshots

read_artifact.desc: Read an artifact produced in this run (for downstream nodes)

list_artifacts.desc: List artifacts already stored for this run

ask_question.desc: Clarify (react) nodes only: ask structured multiple-choice questions (options may be marked recommended; at most one for single-select, one or more for multi-select)

ask_form.desc: Preflight only: show a plaintext form (text|url; passwords as text). Hover why explains the plan gap. Submit enters the dialogue — does not replace set_preflight

set_plan.signature: set_plan(goals, architecture?, data_design?, interfaces?, components?, interaction?, test_design?)
set_plan.desc: Plan/Grasp: write a two-level plan; optional six SDD sections (use 不涉及 when N/A) + Mermaid diagrams

get_plan.desc: Read the global plan (including each item's status)

update_plan_status.desc: Implement node only: update plan item progress

set_clarified_requirement.signature: set_clarified_requirement(title, summary, background, goals, in_scope, out_of_scope, functional_requirements, assumptions, dependencies, constraints, …)
set_clarified_requirement.desc: Clarify (react) node only: write a full requirements spec to clarified_requirement.json (no timeline / tech design)

set_preflight.desc: Preflight only: write the confirmed environment checklist to preflight.json (passwords plaintext; fields may be empty for no-gap)

get_preflight.desc: Read the environment checklist for this run

set_research.desc: Research node only: write structured research to research.json

set_root_cause.desc: Grasp only: when clarified work_kind is bug, write root_cause.json (JSON report, not page.html)

set_proposals.desc: Mandatory on proposal nodes; on Grasp only when ≥2 real alternatives (no single-candidate pseudo-choice)

set_test_result.desc: Test node only: write test summary to test_result.json

set_review.desc: Review node only: write review conclusion to review.json

set_implementation_result.desc: Implement node only: write implementation result to implementation_result.json

set_preview.desc: app_preview or Grasp: register sandbox port or external http(s) URL (exactly one); URL may include a port; iframe direct, no server probe. On Grasp this is optional and does not end the node

set_artifact_preview.desc: react/grasp: focus an existing artifact tab (platform auto-pins new/changed visible artifacts; use demoHtml for option-by-option compare)

node_complete.desc: All agent nodes: mark success|failed before finishing; default checks run first, then optional business RPC

list_run_history.desc: List run execution history (progressive disclosure); scoped to current stage by default

get_history_detail.desc: Drill into one execution/gate detail (status, output, vars; gates include human actions)

memoryStore.name: memory-store
memoryStore.desc: Shared long-term memory · isolated by project+agent
memoryStore.overview: Agent-scoped memory MCP. Progressive list/search then get; upsert conclusions.
memoryStore.convention: Add via Agent Studio ({'${GRASP_MEMORY_URL/TOKEN}'}). Auto-injected in Project Management consult.

contextStore.name: context-store
contextStore.desc: Conversation context · platform auto-stores QA; MCP progressive read
contextStore.overview: Context MCP over ChatThread/ChatMessage. Auto-persisted each chat turn. Agent-isolated.
contextStore.convention: Use list_conversations / get_messages; do not rely on ACP session memory.

taskScheduler.name: task-scheduler
taskScheduler.desc: Agent scheduled tasks · definition MCP; platform executes
taskScheduler.overview: Agent-level cron. Writes only in Project Management consult; each fire uses a fresh sandbox.
taskScheduler.convention: create_job requires Project Management consult. Platform scheduler runs Chat.

pmProgress.name: pm-progress
pmProgress.desc: Project Management only · project progress / blockers (read-only)
pmProgress.overview: Project progress MCP injected in Project Management consult when enabled.
pmProgress.convention: Enable under Project → Project Management settings.

pmWorkflowRead.name: pm-workflow-read
pmWorkflowRead.desc: Project Management only · read-only workflow queries in the same project
pmWorkflowRead.overview: List/get/graph/versions/runs plus pending gates, scoped to the current project.
pmWorkflowRead.convention: Enable under Project → Project Management settings.

pm_get_artifact.desc: Read full artifact content in pages

pmWorkflowWrite.name: pm-workflow-write
pmWorkflowWrite.desc: Project Management only · workflow write operations in the same project
pmWorkflowWrite.overview: Create/update/copy/delete workflows, publish, start runs, approve gates and cancel runs, scoped to the current project.
pmWorkflowWrite.convention: Enable under Project → Project Management settings.

pm_create_workflow.signature: pm_create_workflow(name, description?, needsRepo?, nodes?, edges?, variables?)

pm_update_workflow.signature: pm_update_workflow(workflowId, name?, description?, needsRepo?, nodes?, edges?, variables?)

pm_react_reply.desc: Submit one review ReAct turn without forcing completion by default

pmAgentFs.name: pm-agent-fs
pmAgentFs.desc: Project Management only · read org and edit report Agent workspaces
pmAgentFs.overview: Read virtual groups and flat same-project member view (self/direct/other); list/read/write/delete/mkdir/rename host-side workspace/ for any same-project agent. Does not touch Run sandboxes or agent.json metadata.
pmAgentFs.convention: Enable under Project → Project Management settings (on by default for new projects; older projects with an explicit EnabledMcps list must opt in). Changes appear in Agent Studio「Agent workspace」after refresh/reopen (not live hot-reload). Warning: if Studio has an unsaved dirty draft for the same Agent, a later Save may overwrite MCP writes — refresh and avoid concurrent dirty edits.

pm_create_agent_from_template.desc: Create an engineer Agent from a template (same project; no overwrite)

pm_set_org_membership.desc: Set virtual group membership (groupIds must be in allow-list)

pm_ensure_child_group.desc: Idempotently ensure a child group under the authorized root

pm_fs_write.desc: Write/create file (reason required; auto parent dirs, ≤1MiB; one revision per success)

pm_fs_delete.desc: Delete file or recursively delete directory (reason required)

pm_fs_rename.desc: Rename/move within the same workspace (reason required)

pm_fs_diff.desc: Unified diff vs parent for one revision

pm_fs_restore.desc: Restore full tree to a revision and append restore entry (reason required)

pmPrdManager.name: pm-prd-manager
pmPrdManager.desc: Project Management only · list / get / create requirement drafts
pmPrdManager.overview: List requirement-draft summaries for the current Project Management session project, read a draft body, and create an open draft. List results omit the markdown body; the default title is the unnamed-draft label. This release does not update, change status, or delete drafts.
pmPrdManager.convention: Enable pm-prd-manager under Project → Project Management settings or channel MCP checkboxes (on by default for new projects; older projects with an explicit EnabledMcps list must opt in). Calls fail with mcp disabled when the MCP is not enabled.

pm_list_requirement_drafts.desc: List current-project requirement draft summaries (id/title/status/updatedAt/createdAt, no body)

pm_get_requirement_draft.desc: Read one requirement draft including bodyMarkdown

pm_create_requirement_draft.desc: Create an open requirement draft; blank title uses the default unnamed title

externalProjectMcp.name: external-project-mcp
externalProjectMcp.desc: Project external MCP · Bearer project API key · separate from internal PM Leader
externalProjectMcp.overview: After enabling external MCP, selecting packs, and creating a project API key under Project detail → External MCP, external AI tools (Cursor/Claude, etc.) can call the same five PM pack tool surfaces over HTTP MCP. Off by default; unauthorized or disabled packs are rejected for list/call.
externalProjectMcp.convention: Configure at Project detail → External MCP. Write scope: pm-workflow-write (workflows/runs/gates), pm-agent-fs (org + agent workspace FS), pm-prd-manager (create draft only); pm-progress and pm-workflow-read are read-only. Does not cover PM Leader binding, human collaborators, or Run sandbox files.
